notes.value: Audi A6 e-tron Sportback as sold in Pakistan: the 210 kW rear-wheel-drive car with the 83 kWh battery (75.8 kWh usable) on an 800-volt system, in Signature (PKR 28,850,000) and Executive Edition (PKR 33,850,000) trims that share the powertrain and differ in equipment. 210 kW (282 hp / 286 PS) and 435 Nm, 0–100 km/h in 7.0 s, 210 km/h. 632 km WLTP per PakNEV and PakWheels (about 541 km in real-world use). DC charging up to 225 kW with 10–80% in about 21 min; AC 11 kW. 4,928 × 1,923 × 1,487 mm on a 2,946 mm wheelbase, 143 mm ground clearance, 502 L boot plus a front trunk, about 2,100 kg. Equipment includes 8 airbags, a 14.5-inch MMI touchscreen and 11.9-inch virtual cockpit, a 16-speaker sound system (Signature) and a power tailgate. Warranty 5 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 160,000 km. The larger 100 kWh A6 e-tron (Performance, quattro, S6) is not sold in Pakistan. Sources: PakNEV, PakWheels, Autotijd, Inside Digital.

notes.value: Audi Q6 e-tron quattro, the version Audi Pakistan sells, on the 800-volt PPE platform. Per ADAC: 100 kWh battery (94.9 kWh usable), 285 kW (387 PS / 382 hp) and 855 Nm, all-wheel drive, 0–100 km/h in 5.9 s, 210 km/h, 621 km WLTP at 17.1 kWh/100 km; PakNEV estimates about 535 km in real-world use. DC charging up to 270 kW with 10–80% in about 21 min; AC 11 kW, about 10 hours from empty. 4,771 × 1,939 × 1,685 mm on a 2,889 mm wheelbase, 184 mm ground clearance, 526 L boot plus a 64 L front trunk, 2,325 kg. PKR 48,200,000 ex-factory. Equipment includes the MMI panoramic display (11.9-inch virtual cockpit and 14.5-inch touchscreen), digital matrix LED headlights and OLED taillights, a 360° camera and a panoramic sunroof. Sources: ADAC, PakNEV, PakWheels.
